decisions.evidence: Overall, despite the size and polarity penalties, the very high neutral fraction together with high logP/logD support classification as permeable to cell membranes in a PAMPA assay.

Because the positive-neighbor evidence is at least as strong overall and the molecule retains very high lipophilicity with a near-unity neutral fraction, the combined interpretation supports option (B): is permeable to cell membranes in a PAMPA assay.
